scope: Remove arrows on phones and coarse-pointer devices, preserve desktop controls and original autoplay, fix published dependency advisories; hold merge for unpatched picomatch per user decision.

controls.arrows: Visible only at min-width 640px with a fine primary pointer. Hidden on narrow phones and coarse-pointer devices including landscape phones and touch tablets.
controls.playback: Autoplay remains on by default; Pause/Play retained; explicit pause survives interaction timers.
controls.cue: Swipe to explore on touch/narrow surfaces; Drag to explore with desktop controls.
